svg.title: MARKET RISK AND CVA RISK
svg.desc: Two capital requirements, their approaches and the earlier Basel rules
svg.text: Two capital requirements, their approaches and the earlier Basel rules
K = own funds requirement | RWA = risk-weighted assets
the IMA needs approval desk by desk; other desks use the SA
Securitization positions are out of IMA scope and use the SA (MAR30.4). IMA and SA desks combine in the aggregate requirement of MAR33.43–33.45.
Not drawn: the simplified standardized approach for eligible banks (MAR40).
BA-CVA unless the supervisor approves SA-CVA (MAR50.7)
Advanced CVA risk capital charge: VaR and stressed VaR of credit
spreads, for banks with IMM approval
Netting sets carved out of SA-CVA use BA-CVA (MAR50.8); no netting set is capitalized under both. The revised framework has no internal model approach for CVA.
Each requirement is converted to RWA separately (MAR20.1, MAR33.46, MAR50.1).
Conceptual architecture; not a statement of implemented coverage. Local rules, exemptions and transitions must be checked separately.
Sources: Basel MAR20–23, MAR30–33, MAR40 and MAR50; BCBS, Revisions to the Basel II market risk framework (2009); Basel III (2011).
